faq.label: FAQ
faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Answers to the questions on your mind.

delivery.question: How long does a portfolio site take?
delivery.answer: We typically deliver in 2-3 weeks. Depends on content scope. Priority processing is available for urgent cases.

pricing.question: How much does it cost?
pricing.answer: Varies by page count and feature requirements. Freelancer-friendly packages are available. Clear proposal after a free call.

revisions.question: Can I update the content myself?
revisions.answer: Yes. We deliver an easy content management panel. You can add new projects and write blog posts without asking us.

maintenance.question: Do you provide post-launch support?
maintenance.answer: Yes. 3 months of free technical support after launch. Monthly maintenance packages are available thereafter.

migration.question: Can you migrate my portfolio from another platform?
migration.answer: Yes. We transfer your work from Behance, Dribbble or other platforms to your new site.

mobile.question: How does domain and hosting work?
mobile.answer: We provide full support for domain purchase and hosting setup. We can handle it or guide you step by step.
